business_summary: Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu High-End Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of industrial metal forgings in China and internationally. The company offers bearing forgings, such as marine ring forgings, yaw ring gear forgings, and slewing support forgings for excavators; flange forgings, including furnace flange forgings, rotor room flange forgings, and wind turbine tower flange; and gear ring forgings of speed increasing box. It also provides other forgings comprising brake discs, ball valve forgings, manhole flange cover forgings, steam turbine diaphragm body forgings, friction disc forgings, flange forgings, and wheel forgings. In addition, the company is involved in manufacturing, processing, and design of forgings and general equipment; metal and material inspection and testing services; development of forging processes and materials technologies; and import and export for various commodities and technologies. It serves power generation, nuclear power generation, rail transportation, and marine engineering and machinery industries. The company was formerly known as Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu Special Forgings Co.,Ltd and changed its name to Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu High-End Equipment Co., Ltd. in June 2019. Zhangjiagang Zhonghuan Hailu High-End Equipment Co., Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Zhangjiagang, China.
